requirements.text: The portal must prominently display a direct phone number for patients to easily reach clinic staff if they have questions or need assistance.
Patients should be able to request repeat prescriptions online, with a secure verification process to confirm their identity before submitting requests.
Patients should only be able to view test results after a clinician has reviewed them, ensuring an additional layer of safety.
The portal must comply with relevant regulations to ensure patient data security and privacy.
The design should remain straightforward to avoid overwhelming patients and should facilitate clear communication with clinic staff.
